trigger: The required V67 harness performs real model training and generation, but does not implement the registered k-arm treatment, bf16 cache perturbation, or cache-vs-fresh gate. Extending it would extend invalid evidence.

evidence: scripts/v67_allinone.py:114-290 accepts arm_name but uses it only for logging/result labels and a finite-weight error label
scripts/v67_allinone.py:442-454 loops over k0/k1/k5 without passing k into token construction, masks, positions, model inputs, or loss
scripts/v67_allinone.py:608-634 maps arm names to k only in a post-hoc estimated latency formula
scripts/v67_train.py:149-402 likewise records arm but never uses it in model computation
The tested ddi.link_token_contract.build_request_layout helper is never imported or called by either V67 training script
findings.impact: The reported k0/k1/k5 differences cannot be attributed to link tokens. The scripts do not create link-token arms.

evidence: scripts/v67_allinone.py:62-77 and scripts/v67_train.py:76-98 apply tokenizer.encode followed by tokenizer.decode to document text
No bfloat16 cast, independently encoded K/V tensor, or cache payload is involved in that operation
findings.impact: The registered 0.15 bf16 re-encode perturbation is not implemented. Tokenizer round-tripping can alter text but cannot model the claimed bf16 K/V numerical perturbation.

evidence: scripts/v67_allinone.py:315-338 generates A and D from one monolithic inference.encode batch using ddi_qf and full masks
CanonicalCache and DocCache are imported at scripts/v67_allinone.py:33-34 but never instantiated or called
The real cache path ddi.cache.generate_tokens_with_doc_cache is not called
No B fresh-independent-encoding versus C persisted-cache pair is produced
findings.impact: The frozen cache-vs-fresh non-inferiority gate has no observations. A-versus-D is only a DDI-mask versus full-reference comparison.

evidence: scripts/v67_allinone.py:518 imports paired_bootstrap but never calls it
scripts/v67_allinone.py:603-636 computes only a latency estimate and no EM/F1 confidence intervals or gate verdicts
results/v67_arms_20260910T191742Z/result.json contains per-record A/D metrics but no paired confidence intervals or cache-vs-fresh metrics
findings.impact: The registered two-pair, 10,000-resample seed-47 gate is not reproducibly implemented by the run script.

evidence: scripts/v67_allinone.py:101-107 seeds perturbations with Python hash(record['id']), which varies unless PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed before interpreter startup
The script does not reset torch RNG before each nominal arm, so training-mode dropout can produce differences between otherwise identical arm computations
experiments/v67_preregistration.md freezes 500 steps per arm, while results/v67_arms_20260910T191742Z/result.json reports 300
results/v67_arms_20260910T191742Z contains only full_run.log and result.json: no arm checkpoints
The recorded loss_curve samples step 1 and every 25 steps, not every optimization step
findings.impact: The observed nominal-arm differences and convergence claims are not treatment-identifiable or fully reproducible, and the V67 evidence does not satisfy its frozen budget/artifact contract.

required_remediation_before_a_new_prereg: Implement k0 and k5 in the actual model token stream, masks, positions, training loss, and generation path, with an integration test proving distinct inputs and computations
Define and implement the 0.15 perturbation on independently encoded bf16 K/V payloads, or revise the hypothesis and preregistration to describe the actual perturbation
Evaluate real fresh independently encoded document K/V versus persisted/reloaded document K/V, plus full reference, with per-record predictions
Implement both paired gates using 10,000 bootstrap resamples and seed 47
Use process-independent record seeds, reset all model RNGs per arm, save every-step loss curves and checkpoints, and make the run fail if AdamW8bit is unavailable
Run a corrected V67-equivalent validation before treating V70 as a longer-training follow-up
